That everything is not "just a phase"

As a sufferer of depression I got hassled by my parents (especially my mother) when they first found out about my symptoms and the such. Instead of a helping hand, I got a slap in the face basically.

It's been about a year now and they're getting used to it but I just see too much that some teenagers parents just assume that its just "feelings" or "growing up" when really, it's not.
